title: Pan-Seared Wagyu Steak with Luscious Mushroom Bowl
description: A tender and flavorful Wagyu steak served with a rich and savory mushroom bowl. Perfect for a special occasion or a luxurious dinner.
instructions: Season the Wagyu steak with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the Wagyu steak for 2-3 minutes per side, or until a nice crust forms.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the steak reaches your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, sauté the sliced mushrooms in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet with the mushrooms and stir until melted.
Serve the Wagyu steak with the mushroom bowl and additional butter on the side, if desired.
Enjoy your delicious and indulgent meal!
